B. Is this measure already running in North Karelia wellbeing services county (or in the KYS university hospital area that treats its patients)?
A. Does recent evidence support the size of effect we assume: does this measure raise the share of lung cancer patients who get curative-intent treatment, and by how much?
Measure: Travel and accommodation support for patients far from the university hospital. Patients who must travel for surgery or weeks of radiotherapy get a booked patient hotel, organised transport and a named contact, so that distance is not the reason to choose a non-curative treatment.
effect_summary_en: An English registry study links the longest travel time to lower odds of lung cancer surgery (OR 0.60). It did not test travel support, so the assumed gain of 1 percentage point is not measured.
supported_en: Crawford et al. (Br J Cancer 2009, northern England) found odds of surgery of 0.60 for the most deprived patients who lived furthest from the diagnosing hospital.
not_supported_en: No page shows that travel or accommodation support raises the curative-treatment share, or by how much.
in_use_summary_en: According to KYS's patient hotel instructions from 23.10.2024, patients stay free of charge in three partner hotels in Kuopio. The patient makes the booking and arranges travel between hotel and hospital. Siun sote gives radiotherapy at its own cancer centre in Joensuu.
missing_en: No page shows organised transport, a named contact who makes the booking, or a hotel booked on the patient's behalf.
summary_en: B: KYS (Pohjois-Savon hyvinvointialue) gives patients a free stay in partner hotels in Kuopio, once agreed with their care team. The patient books the room and arranges and pays for the trips between hotel and hospital. Siun sote's cancer centre in Joensuu gives radiotherapy, so long courses of radiotherapy do not need a stay in Kuopio. A: The evidence is only an association: an English registry study (Br J Cancer 2009) found odds of surgery of 0.60 with the longest travel time. No study of the measure itself was found.
unanswered_en: No page was found on organised transport or a named travel contact for Siun sote patients going to KYS, and no study measured the effect of travel support.
